# Security checks reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_checks_doc.py from data/compliance_mappings.json and lib/audit_*.sh. Do not edit by hand; run `make docs`. -->

macharden 1.5.0 runs **54 checks** in four domains: System hardening (21), Network and perimeter (12), Secrets, keys and credentials (11), Persistence and daemons (10).

Every check carries one primary identifier per framework:

- **CIS**: CIS Apple macOS Benchmark (mappings written against CIS macOS 14.0 Sonoma / 15.0 Sequoia Benchmark v3.0.0)
- **NIST**: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control
- **MITRE**: ATT&CK technique, Enterprise ATT&CK Matrix v14.1 (macOS Platform)

The **weight** (1-10) is the check's share of the Hardening Index; [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) describes the scoring model. The complete mapping, including secondary identifiers and reference links, is in [`data/compliance_mappings.json`](../data/compliance_mappings.json).
